description: This source file defines the EventSequenceTokenV2 class, which is a specialized implementation of StreamSequenceToken used to represent sequence tokens with sequence number and event index within the Orleans streaming framework.

classes.name: EventSequenceTokenV2
classes.description: A class that tracks sequence number and event index within a stream sequence, supporting comparison, equality, and string representation.

methods.name: EventSequenceTokenV2
methods.description: Constructor initializing sequence number and optionally event index.

methods.name: CreateSequenceTokenForEvent
methods.description: Creates a new sequence token for a specific event index within the current sequence.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object or stream sequence token based on sequence number and event index.

methods.name: CompareTo
methods.description: Compares this token to another stream sequence token for ordering.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on sequence number and event index.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the token including sequence number and event index.
